$schema.description: An editor hint. The mock ignores it.

dataDir.description: The data directory. A relative path resolves against the configuration file. Without this key, the mock uses ./data in the working directory.

google.description: The TLS listener for the Google hostnames. An omitted field keeps its default: host 127.0.0.1, port 8443.

control.description: The plain HTTP control listener. An omitted field keeps its default: host 127.0.0.1, port 8080.

host.description: The address that the proxy binds.

port.description: The proxy port. 0 picks a free port.

passthrough.description: Tunnel targets other than the Google hostnames instead of refusing them.

proxy.description: The CONNECT proxy. null turns it off. Once the proxy is on, an omitted field keeps its default: host 127.0.0.1, port 3128, passthrough false.

timing.description: The time scale and the delay switch.

scale.description: The factor that divides every quota window, delay, and timeline.

delays.description: Whether modeled latency applies. The search lag and the group delays apply either way.

caFile.description: Where to write the CA certificate. The default is <dataDir>/ca/ca.pem. The CA bundle lands beside it, with -bundle.pem in place of .pem.

readyFile.description: A file that receives the ready event once every domain is ready.

defaults.description: Values that every configured domain shares.

settings.description: A settings patch applied to every configured domain before its own settings.

domains.description: The domains to ensure at startup.

host.description: The address that the listener binds.

port.description: The listener port. 0 picks a free port.

tier.description: The size tier. empty seeds only the root OU and one administrator.

seed.description: The seed: 1 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.

name.description: The district name, 1 to 60 characters. The default derives from the seed.

layout.description: The OU layout. The default derives from the seed.

counts.description: Overrides of the tier counts: schools, students, staff, and devices.

spec.description: The seed specification. The same specification always yields the same data.

onStart.description: keep reuses the domain when its specification and fixtures match. reset seeds it again on every start.

settings.description: A settings patch, merged after defaults.settings.

fixtures.description: A fixtures file, relative to the configuration file.

serviceAccounts.description: The service accounts to issue, each with its delegated scopes.

out.description: Where to write the key file, with mode 0600. A relative path resolves against the configuration file.

scopes.description: The scope set read or read-write, or a non-empty list of full scope URLs.

projectId.description: The project ID: 6 to 30 lower-case letters, digits, or hyphens, starting with a letter and ending with a letter or digit. The default is random.

faults.description: Fault rules that replace the domain faults at each start, in the control API fault format.
